photo_store: git-ignored Data/Reference/raw/textures/NonSkid/<level>/ (crops); originals Data/Reference/raw/j22-lessons/ on the Mac. They show people, so they never go in this public repo.

photos.boat: J/22 TX 7295 EC, North Texas Sailing School, Rush Creek, Lake Ray Hubbard
photos.scale: cam cleat axle spacing 38 mm = 128 px at the coaming
photos.use: pitch, rib direction, seat colour in sun
foredeck colour, clean side and the foot path
side deck and cabin top colour from 3 m

white_reference: each photo's nearby white gelcoat set neutral at sRGB 215; colours below are relative to that

pitch_mm.note: FFT of four 256 px patches on the cockpit seat; the second peak is the rib's own harmonic except one patch (a cross texture at a quarter of the rib's power)

colour_L2.what: side deck from the dock, overcast (patch catches a line and the toe rail edge)
cockpit seat, low sun (white ref in shade, so b is warm)

hero_style_existing.note: the J/22 hero's club preset, read by eye from the same photos earlier

targets.note: Lab relative to a white gelcoat of sRGB 215. L2 is measured; L0, L1, L3 and L4 are derived from L2 and the plan's descriptions until Bean's club photos arrive.

L0.source: derived: pigment from the seat's hue and the hero preset, no grime

L1.source: derived: dust in the grooves only, paths a little greyer

L2.source: measured: mean of the clean side and the foot path (photo 1000032822)
L2.L_std_note: measured on 15 cm photo patches after removing the lighting gradient (raw 12.5-14.8)

L3.source: derived: clean, tops polished in the paths, gelcoat yellowed

L4.source: derived: grey grime throughout, black mildew specks in the grooves

open_items: Coin-in-frame close-up of a lesson J/22's non-skid (square-on, shade) to confirm the 2.3 mm pitch and whether a cross rib exists; the low sun in IMG_9272 may hide one direction.
Photos of a new (L0) and an old neglected (L4) deck at the club; until then those targets are derived.
Sunfish moulded pattern: no photo; it uses the J/22 map for now.
